descripcion: Brewery founded in 1823 on the Kaga plain, a reference for the yamahai method. Own online shop and a tasting room at the kura.
Brewery founded in 1625, the oldest in Kanazawa. Junmai only since 2001; own online shop and a sales room in the city.
Noto brewery working rice from farmers in the village. Still brewing after the 2024 earthquake, with its own online shop.
Brewery founded in 1768, the oldest in Ishikawa, at the tip of the Noto peninsula. Resumed brewing two weeks after the 2024 earthquake.
Brewery on the alluvial fan of the Tetori river. Runs two separate lines, Tedorigawa and Yoshidagura u, brewed in the same kura.
Tsurugi brewery tied to the Hakusan shrine, known for long-aged sake. Its site serves an empty body and could not be read.
